appliedChartDataActions.description: The {@link ChartDataAction}s that were applied to create this {@link ChartDataInfo}.

resultMap.description: Contains all the results keyed by some identifier.

chartToMetricResultKeys.description:
Represents each chart's metric results by providing a list of paths into {@link #resultMap} for each chart.
The key into this map is the chart ID.

chartToEventResultKeys.description:
Represents each chart's event metric results by providing
a list of paths into {@link #resultMap} for each chart.
The key into this map is the chart ID.

reconstructionToHashMap.description:
Maps pre-calculated feature times series name to and it's corresopnding hashed reconstruction time series name
according to series configuration in @see UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChart#data.
This map is currently used in the @see UiSdlDataTransform of the chart component to reorder
the series in the chart to pairfeature series with their corresponding reconstruction series.

chartToConfig.description:
Maps of chart IDs to UiSdlTimeseriesLineBarChart configuration. The UI Chart components should use
derivedProps to set their configurations based on the fields of a specific configuration in this map.

chartToDataTransforms.description:
Maps of chart IDs to an array of data transforms to run on the yAxisField data
after the default UI framework transforms. Every transform listed here MUST be added
to {@link ChartInfoTransformMap}.

title:
Represents chart information that combines both data and configuration details.
This type merges the properties of two interfaces: {@link ChartDataInfo} and {@link ChartConfigInfo}. It encapsulates
the necessary details for rendering and configuring a chart, including both the data to be displayed and the configuration
name: ChartInfo
